6.113 rsInvalidReportItemInPageSection
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidReportItemInPageSection is a non-critical error that will occur when a
Tablix.DocumentMapLabel element, Chart.DocumentMapLabel element,
GaugePanel.DocumentMapLabel element or Subreport.DocumentMapLabel element exists within a
PageSection element or a PageHeaderFooter element.
